name: ipcmanagement
description: Hệ thống quản lý bếp ăn công nghiệp (IPC Management System)

scripts.gen:api:spec: dotnet tool restore && dotnet build backend/src/IPCManagement.Api/IPCManagement.Api.csproj -c Release -p:UseAppHost=false -o .artifacts/contract-build/api && dotnet swagger tofile --output frontend/src/shared/api/contracts/openapi.json .artifacts/contract-build/api/IPCManagement.Api.dll v1
scripts.test:be:coverage: dotnet test backend/IPCManagement.slnx --settings backend/coverage.runsettings --collect:"XPlat Code Coverage" --results-directory backend/TestResults
scripts.coverage:be: npm run clean:coverage:be && npm run test:be:coverage && npm run coverage:be:report
scripts.test:ui-completeness: npm run test:unit -w frontend -- tests/operationalStateActionRegistry.test.ts tests/pcActionCompletenessContract.test.ts tests/pcActionCompletenessFixture.test.ts tests/weeklyMenuPublishPermissions.test.ts tests/uiCanonSourceInventory.test.ts tests/uiStatePurityContract.test.ts --maxWorkers=1
scripts.test:source-ownership: npm run build -w frontend && npm run test:source-ownership:unit -w frontend -- --maxWorkers=1 && npm run test:source-ownership:e2e -w frontend -- --headed && npm run test:ui-completeness
scripts.verify: npm run test:ignore-policy && npm run test:frontend-test-taxonomy && npm run test:frontend-unit-launcher && npm run test:phase05-fixture-determinism && npm run test:architecture-growth && npm run check:architecture-growth && npm run build:be && npm run test:be:ci && npm run lint:fe && npm run depcruise:fe && npm run build:fe && npm run test:fe:unit
scripts.verify:coverage: npm run coverage:be && npm run coverage:fe
